title: MISO MINN.HUB: hours with a negative real-time price
subtitle: Hours per month whose mean real-time price was below zero, 2026-09 to 2026-09
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-25.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO); Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT); Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO); Southwest Power Pool (SPP). Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices; OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute); RTBM LMP by Settlement Location, 5-minute; Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `iso_rtm_hub_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
facts: MISO MINN.HUB: 4 hours had a negative real-time price in 2026-09, the most of the months 2026-09 to 2026-09.
